ev.q: Ten passengers aboard the bus were exposed, including eight students and two staff members.
six persons with blood mercury levels exceeding human health risk thresholds were identified
five family members, including two adults, had elevated blood mercury levels
ranging from 134 µ g/L to >200 µ g/L
The residence had mercury levels of 673 µ g/m 3
Two students and three family members reported acute symptoms on the day of the exposure
which is higher than the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry's recommended levels
To quantify human exposure and assess symptoms, the Iredell County Health Department administered a mercury exposure questionnaire to 23 persons

methods_quotes.q: used a mercury vapor analyzer to determine mercury vapor levels at the residence
The North Carolina State Laboratory of Public Health performed blood mercury testing on 12 of the 23 persons.
